name: Sushi Ginza
description: A crisp, precise and quietly elegant theme for an eight-seat omakase sushi counter: a paper ground, deep navy type and bands, pale hinoki panels and one muted salmon used only for hairlines and plate rings, DM Serif Display over Inter. Every page opens with a magazine masthead (a dateline row, the counter's name set large between hairlines, the menu beneath). The home page reads like a journal's contents page: a cover line and wide photograph, a numbered index of the site, the course card, the chef, the latest journal entries and the seatings. The omakase page lays the evening out in five movements, each marked by a small ringed plate from the plate legend. The footer is a two-tone split: a navy panel with the address and seatings beside a hinoki booking panel. With the chef, omakase, counter booking with policies and an email booking request, journal, newsletter and contact. The seatings and address, and the courses with their prices, are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the masthead wordmark, index numbers, course names and prices
